newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks turn higher on Telmex speculation.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks turn higher on Telmex speculation.

text.p: Mexican stocks staged a late recovery after declining for most of the session to close sharply up after dealers rushed to buy market heavyweight Telmex, which was expected to report 1996 earnings later in the day, analysts and traders said.
"The market bought ahead of Telmex's earnings report,' said Roberto Galvan, an analyst at the Bursametrica consultancy.
The leading IPC share index ended up 24.79 points, or 0.68 percent, at 3,679.13.
Analysts said they had received invitations from Telmex for an "informative session related to Q4 1996 earnings."
